top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a discovery that nature confirmed: the 2011 continuum-model prediction of flat bands at magic twist angles was followed by correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle, reproduced by many groups and generalised across van der Waals moire systems. The citation can rest on the settled flat bands and phase diagram without claiming a pairing mechanism, and the three names (MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer) are the most agreed allocation on the table. The lattice clock (P002) is mature and cleanly attributed but has so far delivered better precision rather than a new result from nature, so I rank it second, well ahead of no award.
